learning_outcomes.text: Knows the flow types and configurations of heat exchangers (cross-flow, shell-and-tube, compact, etc.).
Understands the advantages and disadvantages of heat exchangers based on their applications.
Understands heat exchanger calculations (log mean temperature difference, effectiveness-NTU method).
Understands the characteristics of shell-and-tube heat exchangers.
Understands the application areas of heat exchangers in industrial facilities.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental Concepts and Classification of Heat Exchangers
Flow Arrangements and Compactness in Heat Exchangers
Shell Types in Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers
Front and Rear Head Types in Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers
Fouling in Heat Exchangers and Cleaning Methods
Heat Exchanger Analysis Using the Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) Method
Heat Exchanger Analysis Using the Effectiveness-NTU Method
Various Application Problems Related to Heat Exchangers
Various Application Problems Related to Heat Exchangers
